item.title: Meowdoro 0.1.21
item.description: • Fixed: answered sessions stuck waiting after a restart. In 0.1.20, catching up after a restart could bring back a question from an earlier turn in Claude Desktop on a remote machine, leaving a session yellow and waiting though you'd long answered it. Old questions and reads now stay in the past. A row already stuck goes with that session's next event, or right-click → Remove from List.
